back.es: turn, spin; lap; a walk or ride around (in dar una vuelta); also return, or change (money)
back.example: We're going to take a walk around the park. / Let's take a walk around the park.

note: Because the hint names a lap and a stroll around, it rules out el turno (a turn in a game) and el giro (a change of direction), and it keeps this card apart from the "return" card.
